title: The Witcher 3: Path Traced Hair Unlock
summary: Experimental RTX 40 DOTS triangle fallback for The Witcher 3 Remastered Path Traced Hair.
notes: Only supports the exact DX12 5.0.0.1041720 executable fingerprint.
The renderer is never told that RTX 40 has native LSS support.
Unsupported Linear Swept Sphere geometry is converted into a validated triangle fallback.
Adapted from dashdogy/Michael Robles' MIT-licensed RTX40MFG-Unlock implementation.
